catalogue.note: Header back chevron and the dropdown chevron are icon/chevron/Right exports used as Left and Down, rotated to match the canvas. The frame-level response set the Back row to top-aligned; the instance’s own metadata centres the label, so it sits 4px lower than the response implies. The 10, 14 and 16px strings drew 1px higher than Figma in Chrome, so they carry a measured 1px correction. The 12, 20, 24 and 28px strings needed none.
